meaning: Pharmaceutical tablet, prescription pills, or therapeutic medication.
hand_configuration: Dominant middle finger tip grinds circularly in the center of the non-dominant open flat palm (mortar and pestle grinding motion).
isl_grammar_structure: Medical lexical noun; used in imperative triage requests (e.g. MEDICINE NEED).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Essential medical sign recognized across Indian hospitals and health clinics.

media.description: Middle finger circular grinding on flat open palm mimicking preparation of medicine.
